subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Katheryne in Inazuma City

716560101.text: Ad astra abyssosque, Adventurer. We're thankful for your arrival.

716560103.text: Indeed. We are about to begin a new round of ecological surveys, in fact.

716560106.text: Nonetheless, let me begin by explaining the situation.

716560107.text: Recently, eyewitness reports concerning "Specters" have been increasing at an alarming rate.

716560108.text: This is usually a very rare sort of elemental creature. As such, there must be some special reason behind their sudden resurgence.

716560109.text: The Guild's understanding of these creatures is still very lacking, so we are currently mobilizing for an all-hands-on-deck investigation.

716560105.text: Oh? You've done such commissions before? That's great, then.
